status: LOCAL PASS; UPDATED-APK AND ANDROID PERFORMANCE ACCEPTANCE PENDING
rootCauses: Audio artwork drag/momentum completion directly selected another track; video momentum completion selected/autoplayed another item and also accepted programmatic ends.
DemoCatalog.upsert deleted and reinserted unchanged IDs, replacing row references, reordering lists and notifying all subscribers on no-op cache/thumbnail updates.
One global catalog result/cursor was shared by mounted screens. Repeated query loads reset loaded pages; Search switched to a different data source while Load More was loading.
Fresh per-row callbacks and global-revision subscriptions invalidated memoization. Virtualized image remounts could repeatedly force thumbnail renewal.
Pagination could repeatedly fetch the same request/cursor and used slice(-500), dropping the visible prefix. History keys included global indices and changed when events were prepended.
InstaMus put every match in the FlatList header, bypassing virtualization. Video session lifetime depended on the entire metadata array rather than playback-source identity.
changes: Carousel scrolling is presentation-only. Explicit card taps and existing Previous/Next controls retain selection; original Stage 1 transport/queue code is unchanged.
Scroll interaction refs reject drag, momentum and immediate release presses without queuing deferred playback. Common song rows, Player, Library, History and InstaMus use the guard.
Query-keyed catalog snapshots retain loaded IDs, row objects and cursors across recent navigation. Focus controls debounce/request ownership; identical requests join one promise.
Metadata updates retain insertion order and unchanged object references, with no notification for identical data. Canonical page-cache keys ignore object property order.

Load More retains the visible prefix and data while loading/failing. Failed pagination retries resume the failed cursor. Repeated pages/cursors stop; bounded query caches and a 500-track window avoid unbounded memory.
Stable memoized row callbacks, bounded FlatList batches and independent bounded scroll-position metadata preserve rendering/position without React state updates per scroll frame.
Thumbnail renewal coalesces and is limited to once per song/minute across remounts. Stale artwork responses cannot overwrite newer art.
InstaMus matches/notes are native virtualized rows with stable keys. History keys remain stable when a different event is prepended.

Provider resource/collection page requests use bounded single-flight caching and stable append/deduplication. Existing explicit Load More controls remain; Home discovery has an explicit Load More footer.
Video metadata/artwork updates no longer dispose/reinitialize the native session. Video discovery consumes its own query snapshot.

scope: Scroll gesture/programmatic-event isolation and explicit taps
Stable row props/callbacks, unique keys and bounded virtualized batches
Concurrent and repeated page requests, independent queries, cached navigation, repeated-cursor termination, failure/retry and 500-track prefix retention
No-op metadata publication and canonical query-cache hits
Bounded thumbnail recovery and stale response rejection
Stage 1 rapid selection, Pause/Stop/Play, queue recovery, Next/Previous, Seek and audio/video handoff regressions

android.limits: The Stage 4 source is not in an installed APK. Tests use mocked native/UI boundaries and isolated metadata repositories. No device flicker/FPS/memory measurements or real-scroll playback PASS is claimed.

remainingAcceptance: Repeated fast/slow vertical and horizontal scrolls while Playing and Paused: no start/skip/restart
Audio/video explicit cover taps and transport controls after scrolling; preserve intended state
Load More, network failure/retry, back-navigation and filter/query return: no duplicate rows and retained position
Low-end Android frame pacing, thumbnail failures, rotation and native list recycling
